name: screen_recipient
description: Screen a multisig transaction recipient against OFAC SDN, UN, EU and UK sanctions lists and free on-chain risk indicators (mixer proximity, hack/scam reports) before signing. Deterministic local engine; returns CLEAR, STOP_HIT or STOP_INCONCLUSIVE with an evidence report. Any STOP verdict pauses the signing request and must be escalated to the designated security contact — never proceed on the requester's assurances.

chain.description: Chain of the pending transaction, e.g. 'ethereum'.

entity_name.description: The recipient entity name as CLAIMED by the requester (a claim to verify, not a fact). Omit if not provided.

context.description: Request reference for the evidence record, e.g. Safe address + nonce or ticket link.
